issues.on_page: Schedule 6 prints only combined proprietary figures; p8 prints Garbage / Sewer / Water fund columns
issues.issue: Per-fund detail rule (cities/villages): when the only schedule is a combined one, detail is supposed to be one line per fund column of the proprietary statement. The extractor kept Schedule 6 combined for detail[73]-detail[86]. Defensible because Schedule 6 is a proprietary schedule, but the user may want Garbage/Sewer/Water lines instead.

The statement line is category utilities, but the same line in detail[80] is detail_category professional/contract services. It is a payment to a garbage contractor, so Professional/Contract Services would fit the cost-type rule. The categories are inconsistent.

issues.on_page: Grant proceeds 15,000 (Street fund; operating grant under Public works, p2)
issues.issue: The report does not say whether the grant is state, federal or private. Same for detail[15]. Already marked review.

issues.on_page: Ball Park Summer Rec - Materials & services sold 3,232
issues.issue: This is a recreation fund's charges, which p2 counts as Park and recreation charges for services. recreation/pool/park fees (Recreation Fees) may fit better.
